messages:
Maya: Quick sync — need decision on autoscale fallback for latency-sensitive reserved pools. Customer A wants p95 < 50ms, but their bursts exceed reserved headroom.
Jon: We could avoid hard evictions by routing overflow to a 'latency-fallback' micro-pool with higher cost and smaller batch sizes.
Kevin: Billing implications? If we route to a higher-cost pool, how do we ensure customers aren't surprised? Need credits/alerts.
Sasha: Prototype idea called "softfall": preempt at X% utilization, enter grace_window, then split traffic: 70% to fallback pool, 30% degrade (rate-limit). Keeps latency preserved.
Maya: That sounds promising. Can you sketch minimal policy fields we need in ReserveConfig (so product + infra can agree)?
Sasha: Sketch:
```
reserve_config: {
  preempt_threshold_pct: 85,
  grace_window_s: 15,
  fallback_pool: "latency-fallback",
  fallback_mode: "route|rate_limit",
  billing_flag: "charge_fallback_at_higher_rate"
}
```
Olivia: UX ask: must expose opt-in toggle in console + clear pricing string. Also need a per-tenant fallback report in the billing CSV.
Jon: Runtime note: fallback pool must support lower batching / higher concurrency; kernel selection needs to avoid quantized paths that spike latency.
Kevin: Telemetry we need: fallback_count, avg_latency_before_after, tokens_served_in_fallback, cost_delta.
Maya: Launch criteria proposal: 1) end-to-end perf test with synthetic burst (p95 target), 2) billing + consent UX, 3) alerting on fallback usage, 4) migration doc for customers.
ops-bot: Deploy checklist added: dedicated/fallback-pool/experiment-runbook.md created by @ops-bot
Sasha: I'll write the RFC with config schema + simple migration API. Plan: draft by Wed, review Thu.
Kevin: Also add SLA language: fallback is "best-effort" but we guarantee <100ms 99th in fallback for customers who opt-in.
Maya: Owner Sasha. If RFC approved, schedule canary with ACME customer next week. Anyone object?
Jon: SGTM
Olivia: +1 — I'll block console work in the roadmap.
Kevin: We should also add an escape hatch: manual override to disable routing in case billing bug. `reserve_config.fallback_enabled = false`.
Maya: Great. Action items: Sasha (RFC + config), Olivia (billing + console copy), Jon (runtime feasibility & perf test), Kevin (telemetry + SLA text). Meet Fri 10am to check progress. :thumbsup:
